description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class used to render a complex vertical list in an Android app's home screen. It manages different section types such as header, banner, and content rows, with detailed focus management, view recycling, and layout configuration.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter supporting multiple section types (header, banner, content rows) for rendering the home screen's vertical list with focus handling and dynamic layout adjustment.

classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section, managing brand styling, navbar layout, and focus behavior including recentering logic.

classes.name: BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for banner sections, manages horizontal banner carousels with snapping, focus handling, and aspect ratio sizing.

classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content rows, contains a horizontal RecyclerView for item cards with focus and scrolling adjustments.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for the section item at a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates and creates view holders based on section type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the respective view holders for rendering.

methods.name: HeaderSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds header data, sets brand styling, configures the top navigation RecyclerView with dynamic span count and focus handling.

methods.name: BannerSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds banner data, sets up horizontal scrolling, aspect ratio sizing, snapping, and focus behavior.

methods.name: ContentRowSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds content row data, configures inner RecyclerView, and manages focus navigation and screen visibility.
